title: Heinrich Böll Foundation: International PhD Scholarship
summary: Doctoral support for international applicants with a graduate degree earned abroad who plan to pursue a PhD in Germany.

degree_levels.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

subject_areas.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

values: State or state-recognised university in Germany
institutions.notes: Check the applicable EU/non-EU funding route and any permitted periods abroad.

nationality.notes: The English application page names EU and DAC countries; the German study page and checklists distinguish EU/non-EU routes and DAC priority. These are not an exhaustive country whitelist. Confirm the current route with the provider.

residence.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

mandatory.text: Graduate degree completed abroad and intended doctoral study in Germany.
Complete application through the foundation's online portal.
International applicants must provide German at B2 or DSH 1 level, with a certificate, under the linked doctoral checklist.
Provide evidence of admission to doctoral study and a research plan/timetable. Confirm any late-submission exception with the foundation.

preferences.text: Priority to applicants from DAC countries who are not yet resident in Germany.

funding.description: October 2026 overview: AA-funded non-EU Bildungsauslaender receive a EUR 1,500 monthly base; BMFTR-funded EU/Bildungsinlaender routes list EUR 1,750, plus EUR 100 research/mobility allowance. Family, child and other support depend on the route and personal circumstances. Older checklist rates are superseded by this dated overview; additional income is offset.
funding.duration: Normally three years, with a possible extension of up to six months according to the linked doctoral checklist.

required_documents.text: Application form with CV, motivation, civic engagement and PhD project outline
Degree certificate, translations and explanation of grading where needed
University admission to doctoral studies or justified supervisor confirmation
B2 or DSH 1 German-language certificate for international applicants
Research expose of at most ten pages, including thesis structure and timetable
Third-party civic-engagement reference using the foundation form
Two academic expert reports, one from the main supervisor, using the foundation form
Residence/asylum documentation for refugees where applicable

steps.text: Check the doctoral checklist and formal requirements.
Register and upload the required material.
Submit the complete application before the portal closes.
